newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen rising, mkt sentiment growing.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen rising, mkt sentiment growing.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange will likely rise on Thursday as independent investors gradually return to the market, brokers said.
"The small investors are regaining confidence. They are expected to make fresh commitments," said broker Shahidulla Shamoyl.
Brokers said Square Pharma and Beximco Pharma might attract interest. The DSE benchmark index closed 18.44 points, or 0.7 percent, up at 2,637.84 on Wednesday.
